text:
We all gathered in the halls of the King.
Sirynir, Renbrand, a bunch of lower ranking royal guards and me.
zh:
我们全员在国王的殿堂集合。
西里尼尔、伦布兰德、一群低阶皇家卫兵，还有我。

text: Sirynir, the highest-ranking guard of this group, leads the expedition to the Stone Door northeast of the capital walls.
zh: 西里尼尔是队伍中军衔最高的卫兵，由他率领这次远征，前往王都城墙东北方的石门。

text:
My role is simple - I am the only one with the knowledge to open the doors.
What will we find inside those mysterious ruins?
zh:
我的职责很简单——只有我掌握着开启石门的知识。
那神秘的遗迹里会有什么等着我们？

text:
Gregor, my useless apprentice, once again provided us with too few rations.
While he was on his way to the capital, I took a closer look at the Stone Door.
zh:
格雷戈，我那没用的学徒，又一次把口粮备少了。
趁他赶往王都的工夫，我仔细查看了石门。

text:
Conventional magic seemed useless.
Only astral magic, which is my specialty, caused the gate to glow briefly.
zh:
寻常魔法似乎毫无作用。
唯有我所专精的星界魔法，能让石门短暂地发出微光。

text: Our plan did not remain secret - thieves attacked our group.
zh: 我们的计划终究走漏了风声——盗贼袭击了队伍。

text:
How stupid can anyone be, I thought to myself.
Sirynir and Renbrand are high-ranking guards of the king. The thieves didn't stand a chance.
zh:
我心想，怎么会有人蠢到这个地步。
西里尼尔和伦布兰德都是国王麾下的高阶卫兵，那些盗贼毫无胜算。

text: But why did the thieves attack when they knew full well that they could not win?
zh: 可盗贼明知赢不了，为什么还要动手？

text: After all the excitement, I continued to study the door.
zh: 折腾过后，我继续研究石门。

text:
I succeeded!
Using astral powers, I was able to open the Stone Door.
zh:
我成功了！
借助星界之力，我打开了石门。

text: Sirynir and some of the guards entered the ruins behind the door, while Renbrand, Gregor, and a few other guards waited outside.
zh: 西里尼尔带着部分卫兵进入了门后的遗迹，伦布兰德、格雷戈和其余几名卫兵在外面等候。

text:
Sirynir and his group have been in the ruins for a while now.
They'd better hurry, as night is approaching.
zh:
西里尼尔一行进遗迹已经有一阵子了。
他们最好快点，夜幕将至。

text: No sign of Sirynir and the others.
zh: 西里尼尔他们毫无音讯。

text: Renbrand wanted to follow them into the ruins, but luckily I was able to dissuade him.
zh: 伦布兰德想跟进遗迹去找他们，所幸我劝住了他。

text:
The guards in the ruins should be able to survive on their rations for another day or two.
I suggested waiting out here for a few days.
zh:
遗迹里的卫兵靠随身口粮应该还能撑上一两天。
我建议在外面再等几日。

text:
The expedition failed.
Sirynir and several guards disappeared inside the ruins without a trace.
zh:
远征失败了。
西里尼尔和数名卫兵在遗迹中消失得无影无踪。

text:
The king ordered to return before more men died.
As the others dismantled the camp, I closed the gate to avoid further misfortune.
zh:
国王下令撤回，以免死更多的人。
其他人拆除营地时，我关闭了石门，以免再生不幸。

text: Renbrand is struggling with this.
zh: 伦布兰德对此始终难以释怀。
